say:1:1720830001:1.text: Though our appearance and temperament may differ greatly, in certain respects, Valen and I are not so unlike.
say:1:1720830001:1.source_cn: 尽管外表、性格、行为方式都大不相同，但许多时候，在下认...
say:1:1720830001:1.male: Though our appearance and temperament may differ greatly, in certain respects, Valen and I are not so unlike.
say:1:1720830001:1.female: Though our appearance and temperament may differ greatly, in certain respects, Valen and I are not so unlike.

say:2:1720830002:1.text: Beneath his playful appearance, I can sense his will to survive, his desire to shape his own fate.
say:2:1720830002:1.source_cn: 在他散漫的外表下，我能感受到，他对生存的渴望，对掌控自...
say:2:1720830002:1.male: Beneath his playful appearance, I can sense his will to survive, his desire to shape his own fate.
say:2:1720830002:1.female: Beneath his playful appearance, I can sense his will to survive, his desire to shape his own fate.

say:3:1720830003:1.text: And his curiosity, even restrained, is still vivid enough to slip through in the smallest gestures.
say:3:1720830003:1.source_cn: 以及，即使被他刻意克制，依旧依稀从言行举止中流露出的…...
say:3:1720830003:1.male: And his curiosity, even restrained, is still vivid enough to slip through in the smallest gestures.
say:3:1720830003:1.female: And his curiosity, even restrained, is still vivid enough to slip through in the smallest gestures.

say:4:1720830004:0.text: It leads me to wonder... whether we might be better suited as true kindred.
say:4:1720830004:0.source_cn: 这一切，不禁让我觉得，或许他与我……更适合成为真正的“...
say:4:1720830004:0.male: It leads me to wonder... whether we might be better suited as true kindred.
say:4:1720830004:0.female: It leads me to wonder... whether we might be better suited as true kindred.

say:7:1720830005:1.text: Have you ever wondered how the Solitaries expanded their reach across the entire continent?
say:7:1720830005:1.source_cn: 维伦，你是否想过，为何隐士能够建立起横跨大陆的情报网络？

say:8:1720830006:1.text: Boss, I should make one thing clear. I have zero interest in this topic. Absolutely none.
say:8:1720830006:1.source_cn: 埃德加首领，我要向您严肃申明：我对这件事一点也不感兴趣。

say:9:1720830007:1.text: Oh? Then, about all those times you inquired about the Solitaries in back alleys, and those exchanges with Florian...
say:9:1720830007:1.source_cn: 哦？那么，你过去在街头巷尾打听隐士的情报，以及与老佛里...

say:10:1720830008:1.text: What was all that effort for, I wonder?
say:10:1720830008:1.source_cn: 如此劳心费神，又是何苦呢？

say:11:1720830009:1.text: That was before I joined the Solitaries!
say:11:1720830009:1.source_cn: ……可那些都是我加入隐士前的事了！

say:12:1720830010:1.text: Come on, surely a forward-thinking intelligence organization like this doesn't waste its time digging up the past, right?
say:12:1720830010:1.source_cn: 我说，隐士这么一个有前瞻目光、着眼于最前端情报的顶尖组...

say:13:1720830011:1.text: (Chuckle) There's no need to be tense. I raised the topic. You weren't deliberately prying. Why would I fault you for it?
say:13:1720830011:1.source_cn: 呵呵……无需紧张。是在下主动发起的话题，并非你有意打探...

say:14:1720830012:1.source_cn: 就当作一次普通的闲聊即可。

say:15:1720830013:1.source_cn: 所以，你的回答是？但说无妨。

say:16:1720830014:1.text: Lots of funding, to begin with. A large network of connections. Trade, diplomacy, military reach. Secure communication methods, and inseparable relationships with nobles and royalty.
say:16:1720830014:1.source_cn: 充足的资金、广袤的人脉链、完整的商贸外交军事体系、成熟...

say:17:1720830015:1.text: Oh, and your flock of crows, of course.
say:17:1720830015:1.source_cn: 当然，还有你的那群乌鸦们。

say:18:1720830016:1.text: So you have given this quite a bit of thought.
say:18:1720830016:1.source_cn: 呵呵……这不是对情报网络的建立有过很多思考么？

say:19:1720830017:1.text: A thorough answer. But you've missed one thing.
say:19:1720830017:1.source_cn: 考虑得十分周全，只是还漏了一点。

say:20:1720830018:1.text: A steady hand at the helm.

say:21:1720830019:1.text: Hm. Didn't take you for someone who fishes for compliments.
say:21:1720830019:1.source_cn: 哇哦，你什么时候变得这么需要得到他人肯定了？

say:22:1720830020:1.text: Information is an intimate trade. Even the simplest exchange casts light on both the subject and buyer.
say:22:1720830020:1.source_cn: 情报是极为私密的交易。一次简单的交易，会暴露出众多信息...

say:23:1720830021:1.text: Clients across different factions choose to deal with us because of trust.
say:23:1720830021:1.source_cn: 分布在不同势力范围内的客户，是基于信任，才会选择与我们交易。

say:24:1720830022:1.text: Today, the Solitaries are upheld by reputation. But what about in the beginning?
say:24:1720830022:1.source_cn: 如今的隐士，凭借在业内享有的盛誉做到了这一点。但，最初...

say:25:1720830023:1.text: Time, I guess? How would I know? If you want answers, you should ask your predecessors.
say:25:1720830023:1.source_cn: 靠长时间的积累？我怎么知道。要问的话，你该去问你的前前...

say:27:1720830025:1.text: From the beginning until now, the Solitaries have only had one leader.
say:27:1720830025:1.source_cn: 隐士的统领，从过去到现在，自始至终，只有我一人。

say:28:1720830026:1.source_cn: 艾雅在上，这个笑话可不好笑。

say:29:1720830027:1.text: ... Wait, are you serious? The Solitaries have been around for—
say:29:1720830027:1.source_cn: ……等等，你是认真的？隐士不是已经存在了——

say:30:1720830028:1.text: A very long time. Long enough to spread eyes and ears across the entire continent.
say:30:1720830028:1.source_cn: 漫长的时间。漫长到足以将耳目遍布整座大陆。

say:31:1720830029:1.text: I've had enough time to wander, go gather what was needed... to build a stable intelligence network.
say:31:1720830029:1.source_cn: 我有足够的时间游历四方，积攒所需的财富与人脉，建立稳定...

say:33:1720830031:1.text: ... If this were a deal, I take it that secret would come with an absurd price tag.
say:33:1720830031:1.source_cn: ……如果这是一场交易，要想从你口中换出这个秘密，想必要...

say:34:1720830032:1.text: Oh, but this isn't a deal. It's an invitation.
say:34:1720830032:1.source_cn: 呵……但这并不是一场交易，而是一次邀请。

say:35:1720830033:1.text: As I once invited you into the Solitaries... so now do I invite you to step a little further, to become my kindred.
say:35:1720830033:1.source_cn: 正如当年，我邀请你加入隐士那般……如今，我邀请你，成为...

say:36:1720830034:1.text: A fragile human, touched by a vampire's blood, may cast aside that frailty... and take on a form untouched by time.
say:36:1720830034:1.source_cn: 脆弱的人类，获得强大吸血鬼的血液，便能摆脱孱弱的身躯，...

say:37:1720830035:1.text: I've already spoken to the one who granted me this gift. If you wish it, the transformation can be arranged at any time.
say:37:1720830035:1.source_cn: 我已经向给予我转化的那位提出了申请。只要你想，随时能够...

say:39:1720830037:1.text: Because I see in you the desire to live, and to command your own fate.
say:39:1720830037:1.source_cn: 我看到了你对活下去、掌控自身命运的渴望。

say:40:1720830038:1.text: War has stolen your past, your present, and the shape of the life you might have lived.
say:40:1720830038:1.source_cn: 战争夺走了你的过去、现在与未来，夺走了你原本的人生。

say:41:1720830039:1.text: And yet you still push back. Even knowing the tide is vast, that you cannot hold it.
say:41:1720830039:1.source_cn: 你从未停止过反抗，却也深知自己无法掌控命运，无法抵抗历...

say:42:1720830040:1.text: And your curiosity, I see it too. To secrets, and what lies hidden.
say:42:1720830040:1.source_cn: 我也能感受到你那浓烈、旺盛的好奇……对秘密的好奇，对被...

say:43:1720830041:1.text: We are not so different. Your longings, your regrets... I have walked those same paths.
say:43:1720830041:1.source_cn: 我们是相似的。你所渴求的一切，你的渴望、你的不甘，我也...

say:44:1720830042:1.text: And I reached my answer long ago. We fail only because we lack time.
say:44:1720830042:1.source_cn: 而我，早在许久前就已得出答案。我们之所以失败，只是因为...

say:45:1720830043:1.text: Given enough time, even the impossible may be overturned. Such is the gift of immortality.
say:45:1720830043:1.source_cn: 一切不可能之事，在漫长的时间下，都足以被扭转。这便是享...

say:46:1720830044:1.text: ... You do make it sound tempting. I'll give you that.

say:48:1720830046:1.text: Heh... It seems I still don't understand you well enough.

say:49:1720830047:1.text: You understand me just fine. It's a little unsettling, honestly.
say:49:1720830047:1.source_cn: 不，你很了解我。说实话，你了解我的程度都有点吓人了。

say:50:1720830048:1.text: You're right. I have plenty of regrets, and many things I want.
say:50:1720830048:1.source_cn: 你说得对，我的确有很多想要的东西。我也的确有许多不甘和遗憾。

say:51:1720830049:1.text: But what I want more, is to chase those things in the time I've got.
say:51:1720830049:1.source_cn: 但我更想要的，是在有限的生命中尽力追求那些事物。

say:52:1720830050:1.text: I care about the process, not the outcome.
say:52:1720830050:1.source_cn: 我更在乎这个过程，而不是结果。

say:53:1720830051:1.text: And I'd rather not stretch that out so long that everything that once thrilled me... withers away.
say:53:1720830051:1.source_cn: 更不是将这个过程拉到一个如此漫长的时间，漫长到所有曾带...

say:54:1720830052:1.text: Long enough to watch everyone I care about vanish.
say:54:1720830052:1.source_cn: 漫长到我所有在意的人，都已经在世界上消失不见。

say:55:1720830053:1.text: So you prefer a fleeting life.
say:55:1720830053:1.source_cn: 所以，你更偏好短暂的人生。

say:57:1720830055:1.text: What I want is a short life, that's well lived.
say:57:1720830055:1.source_cn: 我想要的，是短暂却快活的人生！
